title: Midnight Mahjong
description:
STORYSomewhere in Tokyo, in an exclusive mahjong Club.
Rei is a clerk in this club. Her job is to play Mahjong with the guests.
Players will operate Rei and play with 3 guests in the authentic Japanese Mahjong.
Dead wall draw and Last tile from the wall... It all depends on your skills!!FEATURES• Cute character

• Full Audio

• Japanese Mahjong

• Cheat mode
